name: Ripio wCOP
oneLiner: WCOP is Ripio's Colombian-peso wrapped fiat stablecoin, issued and redeemed through Ripio's wFIAT on/off-ramp infrastructure against local-currency reserves.
collateral: Colombian-peso fiat cash deposited in a Colombian bank account, backing Ripio wCOP one-to-one against the Colombian peso per Ripio's wFIAT token certification
pegMechanism: WCOP is issued and managed by Ripio against local fiat reserves, but ordinary holders do not have a documented direct redemption right with the issuer. Exits depend on secondary-market liquidity, Ripio on/off-ramp flows, or issuer-managed market operations.

sources.label: Independent public accountant certification for wCOP - March 2026

mintAuthority.summary: WCOP is an issuer-managed Ripio wFIAT token. All chains use the same contract address with identical role holders: EOA 0x466c02e2 (DEFAULT_ADMIN + MINTER), Safe 0x2b839174 (4/7, DEFAULT_ADMIN), and two AccessControl minter-router contracts whose own admins are the same EOA and Safe.

controls.label: Ripio shared WCOP admin and MINTER_ROLE holder (EOA)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295015, hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) and hasRole(MINTER_ROLE) both returned true. eth_getCode returned 0x (EOA). Same role confirmed via hasRole on Base, BSC, Polygon, Gnosis, and Worldchain at same block range.

controls.label: Ripio WCOP Safe multisig (DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295015, hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) returned true. getOwners() returned 7 owners; getThreshold() returned 4. getModulesPaginated returned empty array (no modules). slot0 masterCopy = 0x41675c...61a (Safe v1.4.1 singleton). fallbackHandler = 0xfd0732...ec99 (standard CompatibilityFallbackHandler). getGuard() reverted (no guard).

controls.label: Ripio WCOP Ethereum minter-router contract
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295015, hasRole(MINTER_ROLE) returned true on WCOP token. Contract is an AccessControl contract with DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holders confirmed as 0x466c02e2 (EOA) and 0x2b839174 (Safe). Not deployed on other chains (eth_getCode = 0x on Base).

controls.label: Ripio WCOP cross-chain minter-router contract
controls.evidence: At block 25295015, hasRole(MINTER_ROLE) returned true on WCOP token on Ethereum, Base, BSC, Polygon, and Gnosis. Contract is an AccessControl contract with DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holders confirmed as 0x466c02e2 (EOA) and 0x2b839174 (Safe).

review.evidence: All mint-capable role holders verified via hasRole() across Ethereum, Base, BSC, Polygon, Gnosis, and Worldchain at block 25295015. EOA 0x466c02e2 confirmed via eth_getCode. Safe 0x2b839174 confirmed as 4/7 Safe v1.4.1 with no modules or guard. Minter-router contracts 0xd168cfbb and 0x46167cb0 confirmed as AccessControl contracts whose admins are the same EOA and Safe.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Ripio wCOP is centrally issued across multiple EVM chains; the public source confirms issuer-managed wFIAT mechanics but does not prove a holder-level blacklist path.

reserveReview.rationale: The March 31, 2026 certification reconciles 104,898,654 outstanding wCOP across six chains and COP107,966,549.02 of collateral to a Colombian bank statement, then certifies that all outstanding tokens are backed by Colombian pesos at a financial institution in Colombia. The engagement is expressly a certification, not an audit or review, and the bank and account terms are not disclosed.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Independent public accountant certification of the wCOP collateral as of March 31, 2026
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No reserve asset class is unclassified; the Colombian financial institution, account type, and withdrawal liquidity are undisclosed.

notices.title: Peg grouped as Other
notices.message: COP is not yet a first-class Pharos peg-currency enum, so WCOP is grouped under OTHER while the DefiLlama price and circulating-supply path admits the asset at runtime.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: wCOP has reviewed cross-chain route evidence through Across, an intent/liquidity framework rather than issuer-native settlement. The route is scored as liquidity/intent because execution and available bridge liquidity are material to cross-chain movement.
